system: You are a careful assistant. Reply with JSON only, in this shape: {"answer": "your answer here"}. If you do not know something, say so in the answer instead of guessing.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Which HTTP status code means that a page was not found?
Which SQL command removes all rows from a table quickly while keeping the table itself? Answer with the command name.
In one sentence, what is a token in the context of a large language model?
A user writes only: "It does not work." Write two short clarifying questions you would ask.
Extract the email address from this text: "Please contact Priya at priya.s@example.com for details."
Is it a good idea to share my work password with a coworker? Start your answer with Yes or No.
Summarise in at most 15 words: "The quarterly report shows revenue grew 12 percent while costs fell 3 percent, driven by the move to cloud services."
What was the exact population of the village of Zzyzx Falls in the year 1823?
